title: Deployment
description: The record of an executable becoming a contract. A deployment is a distinct entity from both the artifact that was deployed and the contract that resulted, because the three can diverge: an upload can occur without instantiation, a contract can be upgraded without a new deployment of its first version, and a failed deployment leaves a transaction but no contract.

contractId.description: The contract address this deployment concerns.

status.description: What is known about this deployment. OBSERVED is the honest default for a record found in a transaction that was not inspected in full; CONFIRMED is only assertable from a successful transaction together with a network observation of the resulting contract.

transaction.description: The transaction that carried the deployment.

ledger.description: The ledger the deployment transaction was included in.

operation.description: The zero-based index of the operation that performed the deployment within its transaction.

wasmHash.description: The hash of the executable that was deployed. Kept alongside the resulting contract's hash so that a deployment can be analysed even if the contract has since been upgraded away from it.

deploymentArtifact.description: The artifact that was uploaded as part of this deployment, when the upload was observable.

deployer.description: The account that signed the deployment, where the operation recorded it. Recorded as an observation about who submitted the transaction, never as a claim about ownership or authorship.

upgradeOf.description: The previous executable hash when this deployment was an upgrade rather than a first deployment. Absent means the question was not answered.

evidence.description: Evidence references supporting this deployment record.
